name: Swancor Advanced Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Swancor Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells corrosion-resistant materials, wind turbine blade materials, and new composite materials in China, Taiwan, and internationally. It offers vinyl ester resins, special unsaturated polyester resins, infusion resins for wind turbine blades, hand lay-up resins, mold resins, adhesives, pultrusion resins for wind turbine blade beams, wind turbine blades and marine infusion HYVER resins, recyclable thermosetting resins, environmentally friendly resins, and safety materials for rail transportation.
